name: BLACKLIST
description: Blocco immediato (403) per qualsiasi richiesta verso la ricerca interna (?s= o /search/) o con filtri prodotto (filter_*, min_price, max_price) priva di referer interno valido.
expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "s=" or http.request.uri.path contains "/search/" or http.request.uri.query contains "filter_" or http.request.uri.query contains "min_price" or http.request.uri.query contains "max_price") and (http.referer eq "" or not http.referer contains "{DOMAIN}")

conditions.title: Ricerca e Filtri WooCommerce senza Referer Interno
conditions.desc: Blocca richieste alla ricerca e ai filtri layered navigation di WooCommerce se prive di referer interno.
conditions.expr: (http.request.uri.query contains "s=" or http.request.uri.path contains "/search/" or http.request.uri.query contains "filter_" or http.request.uri.query contains "min_price" or http.request.uri.query contains "max_price") and (http.referer eq "" or not http.referer contains "{DOMAIN}")
